Right.

I think he's wrapping up some of the approval on the packaging and pricing changes. That's going to be exclusive for you guys as we discussed.

content.text: Got it. Okay. Yeah, I think I had today one of the account executives from Salesforce ask if the pricing would be applicable.

All right. Thank you both. Gentlemen, thank you for a good one.
